split: Fixed23503 training/3970 validation pixel-disjoint manifests; no test during training
method: Full emotion-path gradient fine-tuning with training-only small affine/brightness/contrast augmentation, distinct backbone/head learning rates, cached training-only self-distillation and EMA. Architecture unchanged.
EMA: warm-start decay min(.995,(1+updates)/(10+updates)); batchnorm references fixed
loss: Weighted CE label smoothing .02 for every training face. KL regularization only where the frozen teacher correctly labels a training face. No training example is excluded from CE.
selection: Validation-only score .4 accuracy+.6 macro F1, requiring accuracy,macro F1,disgust recall/F1 no lower than initial raw validation. Compare student and EMA each epoch.
test: One frozen selected candidate only if validation improves; all6561 retained test faces/all7 labels/errors; historical test not fresh. No80% promise.
teacher: Previously deployed project FusDenseNet; no external teacher model or new dataset
physiology: No new aligned face/physiology data; no physiological performance improvement claimed.
